checks: X-axis exhaled volume increases right; expiratory flow positive upward.
Both curves rise steeply near left then descend to baseline on right.
Obstructive descending segment below reference and concave upward, not convex or inspiratory.
Explicit expiratory-only and schematic labels; no fabricated measured values.
validation.pixelReviewNotes: Flow axis points upward, exhaled-volume axis right. Both curves rise near left then return to baseline. Solid coral descending segment lies below dashed reference and is concave upward after its early peak; direction arrow points down-right. Explicit expiratory-only and schematic-not-patient-data labels. No diagnostic recording invented.
